rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for work seen as low-status or requiring little skill.

example.english: Although this is menial work, at least it is stable and does not require working nights.
example.traditional: 呢份工雖然低級，但勝在穩定，唔使捱夜。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 seoi1 jin4 dai1 kap1 daan6 sing3 zoi6 wan2 ding6 m4 sai2 ngaai4 je6

rows.note: Use this for physically demanding, routine manual or household menial work, rather than every kind of low-skilled job.

example.english: Doing menial chores like this is really physically demanding.
example.traditional: 做家務呢啲粗活，真係好花體力。
example.jyutping: zou6 gaa1 mou6 ne1 di1 cou1 wut6 zan1 hai6 hou2 faa1 tai2 lik6
